title: Web3 is dead? Why crypto developers are pivoting to AI

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: Is Web3’s demise signaling a new era where AI becomes the dominant force in crypto development?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Blockchain and AI are merging—zero-knowledge proofs enable private AI training on decentralized data.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But where’s the guardrail? AI trained on biased or exploitative crypto data could entrench systemic inequalities.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Developers are building AI ethics layers—like transparent data provenance and algorithmic audits on-chain.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: Imagine a world where AI-driven DeFi is fair, inclusive, and auditable by anyone, anytime.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The future isn’t about Web3 or AI—it’s about how they evolve together toward responsible innovation.

video_cue: A holographic interface displaying AI models learning from decentralized data streams in a transparent blockchain environment.
